name: Open plan
description: Kitchen, entry, dining room and living room form one open space; motion lights the whole space, wall buttons stay room-local.
rules: The rooms of an open space act together for motion: motion in any room of an open space counts as motion in every room of that open space.

When motion is detected and the house is awake, turn on the main overhead lights at standard in the room with the motion and in every other room of the same open space. Other lights are left as they are.

When motion is detected and the house is asleep, turn on only the indirect lights, at soft, in the room with the motion and in every other room of the same open space. Main overhead lights and decorative lights stay off.
Motion never changes a light that is already on.
Motion never changes anything outside the room with the motion and its open space.
When motion is detected while the house is away, change nothing.
The wall button only ever changes lights in its own room, even when that room is part of an open space.
When the wall button is pressed in a room where all lights are off, turn on the main overhead lights in that room: at standard if the house is awake, at soft if the house is asleep.
When the wall button is pressed in a room where at least one light is on, turn off every light in that room.

On a motion timeout, turn off the lights in the room or open space that timed out that were turned on by motion. Lights that were turned on by the button stay as they are, and nothing outside that room or open space changes.
When the house goes to sleep, turn off every light in every room and close all blinds.
When the house wakes up, open all blinds. Lights are left as they are.
When everyone leaves, turn off every light in every room.
When someone arrives home, change nothing. Lights come on later from motion or the wall button.
Blinds only change when the house goes to sleep or wakes up.

accessories.description: decorative pendant lights over the island
